# Helvetra

> The very Swiss translation app. Helvetra translates between Swiss German, German, French, Italian, Romansh and English, with a particular focus on Swiss German dialects.

Helvetra is a privacy-first translation tool and API, built in Switzerland and running on Apertus, an open Swiss AI model, on Swiss infrastructure. Text is processed and then discarded: it is never stored or used to train models. Swiss German is a family of spoken dialects with no single written standard, so Helvetra lets users choose a dialect (Bärndütsch, Züritüütsch, Baseldytsch, Sanggallerdütsch, Walliserdütsch, Luzärndütsch) and treats it as a first-class language rather than an afterthought. Helvetra is not affiliated with Apertus or Infomaniak.

## Translate
- [Swiss German translator](https://helvetra.ch/swiss-german-translator): Translate to and from Swiss German with a choice of dialects
- [English to Swiss German](https://helvetra.ch/english-to-swiss-german): Translate English into Swiss German
- [Swiss German to English](https://helvetra.ch/swiss-german-to-english): Translate Swiss German into English
